title: Ops Weave: Standup + Handoff Notes (2027-11-30)
body:
Quick summary:
- Standup time: 2027-11-30 09:30 PT (30m) — lightweight, focussed on two active incidents and SLO drift.
- Primary for next 24h: Mei Chen (day), Liam O'Connor (follow-through), on-call rotation: David Okafor (night).

Incidents (brief):
1) KV-cache thrash causing P95 tail latency spike (INC-SRE-1428) — detected 2027-11-29 22:18 PT
   - Symptom: sustained P95 jump from baseline 110ms -> 320ms for text-generation route /v1/generate. Spikes correlated with cache eviction churn on warm nodes.
   - Probable root-cause (working hypothesis): an interaction between recent LRU-change (serving-runtime #842) and the new prefix-caching TTL heuristics; under bursty short-context workloads eviction loops occur and cold misses cascade into heavier kernel paths.
   - Mitigation applied: reverted TTL heuristics flag on Canary pool at 23:10 PT (measured immediate P95 drop to ~140ms). Canary rolled to 3 racks.
   - Next steps: put a safety throttle around cache-repopulate (PR authored, reviewer: Ana). Follow-up RCA in SRE-1428.

2) Autoscaler mis-provisioning for dedicated-pools (INC-SRE-1431) — detected 2027-11-30 03:04 PT
   - Symptom: pods remained in Pending behind node-selector mismatch after infra tag change; burst requests hit capacity floor and produced 429s on dedicated customers for ~18m.
   - Mitigation: temporary override added to autoscaler policy to ignore node tags (04:00 PT) while infra tag fix rolled out.
   - Impact: small number of high-priority Dedicated customers saw degraded throughput but we avoided a broader outage.

SLO snapshot (current vs target):
- Text-gen request latency P95: target 120ms -> observed 135ms (24h window) -> action: chase cache RCA, add short-term rate-limit smoothing on bursts.
- Error rate (5xx) global: target <0.5% -> observed 0.72% (spike windows only).
- Availability (hosted-api): target 99.95% -> current rolling 99.94% last 7d.

Runbook / Observability notes:
- Grafana dashboard updated with new cache eviction heatmap panel (link above). Use the "eviction_rate" panel to correlate with p95 spikes.
- Temporary alert: SLO-SoftAlert-Gen-P95 raised threshold to 130ms for Canary windows to avoid alert fatigue while we monitor the rollback effect.
- Pager play: if 5xx spike > 1.5% for > 5m, engage on-call and escalate to eng@infra.

Handoff (to night shift):
- Mei: leave notes on the Canary rollback status, confirm canary remains at 3 racks at midnight PT — action: mark in this doc when stable.
- Liam: follow PR review for serving-runtime #842 and land the short TTL-safety flag by EOD PST. If blocked, escalate to Raj.
- David (night): monitor 12:00–08:00 PT window; primary watches: P95, eviction_rate, pod Pending counts for dedicated-pools; secondary: EBS latency panel.
- Contact matrix: oncall@redwood.sre, infra-lead@redwood (Nora Blake), eng-runtime@redwood. Cell numbers listed in runbook.

Open action items (short list):
- [A-1] PR: add TTL-safety throttle and integration test for eviction regression — owner: Ana Martínez — due: 2027-12-03 — Jira: SRE-1429.
- [A-2] Autoscaler policy fix to respect new infra tags (but keep backward compat) — owner: Mei Chen — due: 2027-12-02 — Jira: SRE-1432.
- [A-3] Add synthetic probes for dedicated-pool cold-start latency (short-context) — owner: Liam O'Connor — due: 2027-12-07.
- [A-4] Post-incident retrospective write-up and RCA for INC-SRE-1428 — owner: Raj Patel — due: 2027-12-06.

Notes to self / rough ideas (brain-dump):
- Consider an eviction backoff window tied to observed QPS bursts, not just cache size. Might reduce cascading misses. Prototype simulation next week.
- Revisit autoscaler test harness: add tag-change test to CI to catch node-selector drift earlier.

Meeting takeaways / decisions:
- Short-term: keep TTL heuristic rolled back on Canary and extend to 50% of prod if no regressions for 24h.
- Medium-term: land TTL-safety throttle and add eviction-rate SLOs for cache subsystem (proposal on Confluence).

Appendix (quick links & artifacts):
- Incident tickets: JIRA:SRE-1428, JIRA:SRE-1431
- PRs: https://github.com/redwood-inference/serving-runtime/pull/842
- Runbook: https://confluence.redwood.company/display/SRE/Ops-Weave-Runbook
- Dashboards: https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/latency/overview?orgId=1

If anything changes while I'm offline, ping on slack #sre-ops and add a short line here with timestamp.

-- Raj
(Notes: rough draft for the on-call handoff doc; will clean up for Confluence RCA after primary mitigations are complete.)
